texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "兄弟,你听说过老被诈吗?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "什么老被诈?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 18], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "老被诈,由人类吐槽抱怨凝聚成的怨铃。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 29], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "他专门将人抓走炸死,让人类抱怨声更多,从而使自己更加强大。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 18], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "大晚上的,你给我在这儿讲恐怖故事呢?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "真的有这种东西,你别不信我。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 17], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "不是怎么越听,这怨铃越像咱们俩呢?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "好,跑,三。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "兄弟,我是叫人!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 4], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "你大爷!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 16], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "看来跑是跑不掉了,那就跟你干了!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 3], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "背心!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 17], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "宝贝,今天我也让你尝尝被罩的滋味!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "上吧,宝宝!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我带我大侄子来救你了!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 17], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "上吧,大侄子,真的很擅长玩香蕉皮。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "这是我的招式。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "叫百分之百空脚踩香蕉皮。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 18], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "每当我扔香蕉皮时,它都必须踩在上面。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "这就是机制。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 20], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "必须要吃进肚子里,不然我的招式不会生效。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 4], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "听到没?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我再压个起身。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 4], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "失效了?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "小黑黑,什么情况?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 4], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我走位!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "他鸟了个腿的拿东西给我拿好!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "怎么拿香蕉的?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 4], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "不香蕉!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 3], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "不险!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "让我闹玩意儿一直出香蕉是吗?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "打你出香蕉!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 13], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我让你叫人,你还会干什么?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 10], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "躲在角落里玩鸟阴人。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 21], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "你个矛盾,我现在允许你去叫人,把鸟掂起来!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 23], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我就让你看着,我是如何把你的好伙计们全部炸死!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 15], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "没有别人的帮助,你狗屁都不是!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "一生只靠别人活着的废物!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "这是什么物种?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 24], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "可怜的孩子,因为战争没了家,以后就由我收养他吧。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "蓝灯,你应该发现了吧?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 28], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "GTI为了完成任务,不择手段,甚至是不顾其他平民的性命。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "卡尔,我们又改变不了这一切。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 16], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我们已经老了,该想想怎么退休了。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 39], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "听着蓝灯,哪天我如果死了,请帮我照顾好我的孩子,他现在在GTI服役,代号红狼。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 16], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "很抱歉,卡尔的直升机遭遇了袭击。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "那就去搜救啊!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 20], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "上集给出过指示,任何人不得擅自搜救卡尔。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 45], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "GTI你记住,从今以后,我将封印我全部的力量,不会再执行你们任何任务,大不了我退出GTI。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "来,卡尔,我自己去找。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 20], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "这款手机,傻服为您服务,请输入开机密码。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "人,力量转移。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "来吧,你展开!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "死我的力在你身上。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 10], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "你别忘了,是一个人。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 13], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "不行了,兄弟,你要炸缸了。"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "现在,把剑捡起来。"}
